status: Reconciliation proposal only; word timings and renderer not edited by this review.
methods: Fresh broad original-mix/estimated-vocal/estimated-accompaniment final-word spectra for all 27 cues.
Separate independent close final-body/decay and actual v3-opacity inspection for 15 verse/chorus cues.
Original/stem/accompaniment 40ms RMS on a 10ms grid supports amplitude decay; energy alone does not identify speech.
Original source remains authority; equal-length zero-observed-lag estimated stem supports identity only.
limits: These are model/signal estimates, not human normal-speed/reduced-speed listening attestation.
Direct articulation can be quiet or constant-pitch; stationary harmonic decay alone does not establish reverb.
Close-gap decay overlaps new voice and cannot yield an isolated absolute reverb stop.
Low-confidence filtered radio tails overlap music/static; farther stationary tones are not more words.
Selected neutral legibility lifetime is presentation data, not an extension of word focus.
Sample integers encode review selections; they do not establish millisecond perceptual accuracy.
